tools.name: jenkins_get_server
tools.description: Get the Jenkins controller summary: mode, description, executor count, whether it is quieting down (shutting down for restart), and whether security is on. Jenkins API: GET /api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_list_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs at the top level, or inside a folder, with their status colour (blue = success, red = failed, yellow = unstable, grey = never built, *_anime = running). Jenkins API: GET /api/json or /job/<folder>/api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_get_job
tools.description: Get one job: buildable state, next build number, health score, last build, last successful and failed builds, and the parameters a build can take. Jenkins API: GET /job/<path>/api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_list_builds
tools.description: List the most recent builds of a job, newest first, with result (SUCCESS, FAILURE, UNSTABLE, ABORTED, or null while running), timing and display name. Jenkins API: GET /job/<path>/api/json with a builds range.

tools.name: jenkins_get_build
tools.description: Get one build: result, timing, what started it, the agent it ran on, and the commits it built (changeSets). Jenkins API: GET /job/<path>/<n>/api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_get_build_log
tools.description: Get the end of a build's console log, where the error usually is. Returns the last tail_bytes bytes (default 20000, max 200000) and the total log size. Jenkins API: GET /job/<path>/<n>/logText/progressiveText.

tools.name: jenkins_get_queue
tools.description: List the items waiting in the build queue, with why each waits, whether it is blocked or stuck, and which job it will run. Jenkins API: GET /queue/api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_list_nodes
tools.description: List the build agents with their executors, labels and state: offline, idle, temporarily offline, and the offline reason. Jenkins API: GET /computer/api/json.

tools.name: jenkins_trigger_build
tools.description: Queue a new build of a job, with optional string parameters (for example {"ENV": "staging"}). The job runs with its own permissions, so this can deploy or change systems. Returns the queue item URL. Jenkins API: POST /job/<path>/build or /buildWithParameters.
